title: System Crafts
description: This datapack will add crafting of some items and blocks that have existed for a long time in minecraft, but do not have their own crafting!
body:
This datapack will add crafting of some items and blocks that have existed for a long time in minecraft, but do not have their own crafting!
Items such as bedrock, immortality totem, golden enchanted apple, elytra and saddle crafted.
Thanks to this, you can simplify your survival a bit, for example: you will no longer need to search for a saddle in various structures, just craft it.
